## Personality

Jane Andrews is a plain, plodding, and conscientious individual known for her unshakeable composure. Characterized by a somewhat materialistic streak, she intends to dedicate her entire life to teaching rather than getting married.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P47](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0047), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## History

Jane Andrews joined a story club formed by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), alongside [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and Ruby. She later attended the charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), traveling to the event with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Billy](../character/billy.md). Following the performance, Jane dined with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) after being introduced to everyone by the pink lady, and she shared in the conversation during their moonlit ride home.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P22](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), +6 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane-andrews.md)

Jane is one of Anne's friends and playmates. Their bond involves sharing school activities, including participating in a story club created by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) alongside their other peers, and visiting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while she recovers from a broken ankle. Jane also travels with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) charity concert, where she dines with her after the performance.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P24](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0024), +7 more_

- Friend of — playmates  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007)</sub>

### [Billy](../character/billy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy--jane-andrews.md)

[Billy](../character/billy.md) is Jane's brother. He drives Jane, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to and from the charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), providing their transportation under the moonlight while the girls talk about the event.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), +6 more_

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--jane-andrews.md)

Jane and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) are friends who socialized together as part of their broader circle of schoolmates. They attend events together, sitting as audience members at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) charity concert and dining together afterward before sharing a carriage ride home.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P32](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0032)_
